entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I hope you can help. I have one of your VeloBand trackers, and... it's just not working. I'm so confused by it all.

I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can definitely look into that. To get started, could I get your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account? And just so I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?

Oh, sure. It's Jane Smith. The email is j.smith@email.com. I think it's a technical thing? It seems like the band is broken. The main feature I bought it for, the pulse tracking, is all over the place.
Okay, Jane, thank you for that. I've pulled up your account. I see you have the VeloBand GPS Tracker. Can you tell me a bit more about what's happening with the pulse tracking?
Well, it gives me readings that are way too high, then way too low. And half the time the data won't sync with the app on my phone. I really think the device is defective.
I can certainly understand your frustration. When a device isn't syncing properly, it's not a good experience.
It really isn't. I don't understand all the settings and updates. The website was so confusing when I looked for help. Can't you just help me? I just want something that works.
Of course, Jane, I'm here to help. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see here that your order was delivered 20 days ago, on December 15th.
Yes, that sounds about right. Is that a problem?

Not at all. Let me just consult our policy... Okay, it looks like VeloFit has a 90-day return window for items in their original condition. Since you're only on day 20, you are well within that period. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you right now.
Oh! Really? You can do that? That's a huge relief. I was so worried I was stuck with it. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome, Jane. I've just initiated that return. I'm sending an email to you now with a prepaid shipping label. Just package the defective band back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
That's wonderful. Thank you, David. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure. Once we receive the device, you'll see the refund processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
